variants.prompt: Amidst the decadent opulence of a secret underground club, a stunning dominatrix named Raven holds court, her regal beauty and commanding presence drawing in a coterie of eager worshippers who crave to serve at her pleasure - and receive her merciless punishment. A cinematic shot, illuminated by pulsing neon lights, frames Raven's dominant form against a backdrop of velvet-draped walls and ornate furniture.
